visual_review.review_type: visual inspection of actual formatted sprites, not a game screenshot

findings.expression: Matches the local portrait's opaque glasses, small nose and restrained slightly downturned closed mouth. No invented visible iris or cheerful grin.
findings.identity: Cap/heart, sandy bob, glasses, original orange jacket, polka-dot scarf, navy dress, orange socks, cuff bows and original bag/charm colors remain recognizable at native size.
findings.proportions: Same pixel-scale comparison with Vertin and Arknights references; small face and bold contour. Garment-first A-line silhouette, without imposing fitted waist proportions.
findings.views: True right profile and rear; upright head. Body inclines continuously, gathered compact side foot; no complete arms/hands. Bag follows character-left carry position across views.
findings.occlusion: Front scarf lateral end remains partly visible beyond bob; rear hidden neck accessories are not drawn through hair. Back has no front heart/visor or front coat buttons.
findings.direction_consistency_corrections: Removed the wrong-side jacket buttons and horizontal side toe; corrected back cap band; moved front scarf flap outward for composite visibility.
findings.edges: Clean transparent padding and distinct outside outline on checker and solid backgrounds; no observed clipping or loose glow in formatted images.
findings.face_marks: No obvious characteristic freckles/scars/burns in the local portrait; no added markings.

limitations: Profile/rear structures partly reconstructed from the local front portrait and corroborating item images.
No in-game validation; preview head offset is (0,-65) and is not a universal engine configuration.
visual_review.preservation_claim: Local generative edits were visually compared. They are not claimed to preserve all non-target pixels byte-for-byte.
